Apply the same measurable offset, delay, dependency, correspondence, or recursion across at least three separated affected surfaces. Size and place the matched instances so their shared rule can be inferred from the image without prompt text or a caption, and keep every unaffected hand, face, object boundary, material, perspective, and light response convincingly ordinary.
